verses.gurmukhi: ਦੀਪਕ ਪਤੰਗ ਅਲਿ ਕਮਲ ਸਲਿਲ ਮੀਨ ਚਕਈ ਚਕੋਰ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਰਵਿ ਸਸਿ ਨਾਦ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: dheepak pata(n)g al kamal salil meen chakiee chakor mirag rav sas naadh hai ||

en.bdb: A moth, black bee, fish, ruddy Sheldrake, (Allectoris gracea) and a deer loves flame of a lamp, lotus flower, water, Sun, moon and sound of music produced by Ghanda Herha respectively.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਇਕ ਅੰਗੀ ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗੀ ਨਹੀ ਸੰਗੀ ਕੋਊ ਸਬੈ ਦੁਖਦਾਈ ਨ ਸਹਾਈ ਅੰਤਿ ਆਦਿ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: preet ik a(n)gee bahu ra(n)gee nahee sa(n)gee kouoo sabai dhukhadhaiee na sahaiee a(n)t aadh hai ||

en.bdb: All their love being one-sided is very painful that does not help neither in the beginning nor in the end.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਤ ਨ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗ ਮੂਏ ਨ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jeevat na saadh sa(n)g mooe na param gat giaan dhiaan prem ras preetam prasaadh hai ||

en.bdb: These living beings of subhuman life can neither be blessed with holy congregation of true devotees nor salvation after death. They cannot even be the recipient of Guru's teachings, His contemplation and the divine nectar that the grace of True Guru can dispense.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਾਨਸ ਜਨਮੁ ਪਾਇ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਦਇਆ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਬਿਸਮਾਦ ਹੈ ॥੩੨੧॥
verses.translit_en: maanas janam pai sree gur dhiaa nidhaan charan saran sukh fal bisamaadh hai ||321||

en.bdb: Coming to the refuge of the True Guru, the store-house of mercy and that too in the life of a human being and practicing on the True Guru-given Naam Simran can bless one with that unique fruit of comfort and peace. (321)
